		<div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_0 et_pb_section_parallax et_pb_with_background et_pb_fullwidth_section et_section_regular" data-padding-phone="0px|0px|0px|0px" >
				
				<span class="et_parallax_bg_wrap"><span

				<section class="et_pb_module et_pb_fullwidth_header et_pb_fullwidth_header_0 et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_dark">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_container center">
					<div class="header-content-container center">
					<div class="header-content">
						
						<h1 class="et_pb_module_header">Downwinds in Brazil</h1>
						<span class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_subhead">The best downwinds in the world</span>
						<div class="et_pb_header_content_wrapper"></div>
						
					</div>
				</div>
					
				</div>
				<div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_overlay"></div>
				<div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_scroll"><a href="#" class="scroll-down-container">
					<span class="scroll-down et-pb-icon">;</span>
					
					
				</a></div>
			</section>
				
				
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_1 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				
				
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_0">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_0  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1>Downwinds along the Northeast coast of Brazil</h1></div>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_justified et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>When it comes to <strong>Downwind trips</strong>, <a href="https://www.freeridekitesurf.com/en/kitesurfing-spots/brazil/">Brazil</a> offers the best and widest variety hands down thanks to its geographical location and trade winds which blow from July all the way through to January. In the northeast of Brazil you will discover a mind-blowing 1200 km of coastline kitesurfing <strong>downwind</strong>. The wind blows constantly side-on-shore along the entire coast which allows you to kitesurf from spot to spot following the direction of the wind whilst enjoying all types of conditions. With its unique and magnificent landscapes, mammoth dunes, caribbean watered lagoons only accessible by sea and the endless possibilities to kite every condition imaginable makes Brazil the ultimate kitesurfing destination.</p>
<p>We would never assign more than 12 people to a group and we put all our efforts into making sure that everyone in the group has a similar level. This way, the downwinds flow according to the riders rhythm and above all, safety.</p>
<p>The 4×4 support vehicles always follow the downwinders along the beach (where feasible), allowing riders to stop and rest or change material whenever necessary. There is always a minimum of 1 guide in the water at all times leading the group and when many, another guide is assigned to cover the tail of the riders, providing the utmost control and safety for the group.</p>
<p>Traveling by kite exploring new and untouched spots is an incredible experience. During the journey we always stop for a minimum of 2 nights in each place allowing enough time to get to know all the surrounding spots and to rest. You will sleep in beautiful pousadas only a few meters from the sea and you will get to submerge yourself into their vibrant and diverse culture.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_justified et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>We offer <strong>6 different downwind trips</strong> and <strong>1 </strong><strong>wave riding coaching trip</strong>. Pick the one that suits you best and begin your adventure now. What are you waiting for?</p>
<p><span style="font-size: medium;"><em><strong>* If you cannot find a Downwind trip that interests you, do not hesitate to <a href="https://www.freeridekitesurf.com/en/contact/">get in touch</a> with us as we will do our very best to create one that works for you.</strong></em></span></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">

				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">1. Rio Grande do Norte </h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><em><strong>11 days – All types of conditions – Intermediate level required<br /></strong></em></p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignleft wp-image-5481 size-thumbnail" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/kite_saommiguel3_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Kite trip Brazil" width="150" height="150"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The distinct spots that you find in Rio Grande do Norte offer an excellent variety of conditions when it comes to kitesurf. You will also be given many chances to discover the beauty of its coast as well as the life of its towns. Try out world famous kite spots like São Miguel do Gostoso and others that are more intact, like Galinhos. A Kite Safari that combines adventure, culture and beauty.  </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><a href='https://www.freeridekitesurf.com/en/kite-safari/downwind-brazil/rio-grande-norte/' class='small-button smallblue' target="_blank">More info.</a></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_1 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">1. Rio Grande do Norte</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><em><strong>11 days – All types of conditions – Intermediate level required<br /></strong></em></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img decoding="async" class="wp-image-5481 size-thumbnail aligncenter" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/kite_saommiguel3_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Kite trip Brazil" width="150" height="150"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The distinct spots that you find in Rio Grande do Norte offer an excellent variety of conditions when it comes to kitesurf. You will also be given many chances to discover the beauty of its coast as well as the life of its towns. Try out world famous kite spots like São Miguel do Gostoso and others that are more intact, like Galinhos. A Kite Safari that combines adventure, culture and beauty.  </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><a href='https://www.freeridekitesurf.com/en/kite-safari/downwind-brazil/rio-grande-norte/' class='small-button smallblue' target="_blank">More info.</a></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_2 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">2. East of Fortaleza</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><em><strong>10 days – Lagoons and river mouths – Intermediate level required<br /></strong></em></p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="wp-image-25233 size-thumbnail alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_atins2_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="kitesafaris Brazil" width="150" height="150"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The east of Fortaleza has two of the best flat water spots Brazil can offer. It’s quite surprising that spots like Uruaú, Barra Nova or Parajuru are still unknown to most which is what makes it the perfect moment to jump on board now before it begins to change. You’re likely so see just a handful of kites out at sea and you’ll be mixing with “kite locals’; kitesurfers who have been coming or living in Brazil for many years and who are always in search of newer and better spots. </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><a href='https://www.freeridekitesurf.com/en/kite-safari/downwind-brazil/east-fortaleza/' class='small-button smallblue' target="_blank">More info</a></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_3 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">2. East of Fortaleza</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><em><strong>10 days – Lagoons and river mouths – Intermediate level required<br /></strong></em></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img decoding="async" class="aligncenter wp-image-25233 size-thumbnail" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_atins2_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="kitesafaris Brazil" width="150" height="150"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The east of Fortaleza has two of the best flat water spots Brazil can offer. It’s quite surprising that spots like Uruaú, Barra Nova or Parajuru are still unknown to most which is what makes it the perfect moment to jump on board now before it begins to change. 				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">3. Classic: Taiba to Jericoacoara</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><em><strong>14 days – All conditions- Intermediate level required<br /></strong></em></p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignleft wp-image-25605 size-thumbnail" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_prea5_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwind Brazil" width="150" height="150"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Between these two mystic spots on the coast of Ceará you will discover other kitesurf villages that offer similar or even better conditions whilst also taking part in long downwinds passing truly spectacular scenery. Regardless of however many times you have visited this part of Ceara, you’ll always crave that need to return. </p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">Along the coast of the threw states of Ceará, Piauí and Maranhão, a number of kitesurfing spots are beginning to appear on the map and as the word spreads they are slowly but surely being recommended as some of the top Brazilian spots. Here you will enter the very lush and exuberant north of Brazil crossing the biggest delta in the Americas, the Delta of Parnaiba. Prepare yourself for an adventure!  </p>

				<div class="et_pb_map" data-center-lat="-2.827333096763291" data-center-lng="-40.313513504296914" data-zoom="6" data-mouse-wheel="off" data-mobile-dragging="on"></div>
				<div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-5.1259998" data-lng="-35.64093330000003" data-title="1. Kitesafari Rio Grande do Norte">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">1. Kitesafari Rio Grande do Norte</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25629 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_saommiguel10_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwind Brazil" width="150" height="150">The starting point for this Kite Safari in Rio Grande do Norte is São Miguel do Gostoso. It is a world renowned spot claiming its fame for its strong, constant winds and many different spots.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-4.399874021223884" data-lng="-37.78668359567871" data-title="2. Kitesafari East of Fortaleza">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">2. Kitesafari East of Fortaleza</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25964 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/kite_fortim1-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwind brazil" width="150" height="150">Fortim is the starting point for this Kite Safari east of Fortaleza. On this Kite Safari you will discover the unknown spots east of Fortaleza and you will begin to understand just why everyone is talking about it. Expect spectacular conditions.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-3.6162207147955243" data-lng="-38.749264369836396" data-title="3. Kitesafari Cumbuco - Jericoacoara">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">3. Kitesafari Cumbuco - Jericoacoara</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25333 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_cumbuco3_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwind Brazil" width="150" height="150">Taiba is the starting point for this Downwind trip. This spot is world renowned for its famous lagoon and extensive beaches. From here to Jericoacoara you will kitesurf by unbelievable landscapes, quaint villages and stunning beaches.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-3.0238459445244668" data-lng="-39.65510949873351" data-title="4. Kitesafari Icaraizinho - Luis Correia">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">4. Kitesafari Icaraizinho - Luis Correia</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25445 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_icaraizinho4_980x835-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwind Brazil" width="150" height="150">On this Kite Safari you will experience the strongest winds found in Ceará, Piauí and Maranhão and you will find villages like Icaraizinho which you&#8217;ll never want to leave.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-2.909124917346122" data-lng="-41.41272942908324" data-title="5. Kitesafari Wild North">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">5. Kitesafari Wild North</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25129 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_delta1-150x150.jpg" alt="Kitesurf Delta do Parnaiba" width="150" height="150">On this Kite Safari you will enter the unknown. You will get to explore the coast of Piauí and Maranhão passing through the Delta of Parnaiba and ending in Atins, at the foot of The Lençóis Maranhenses National Park.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_map_pin" data-lat="-2.5672034974085642" data-lng="-42.74423388122864" data-title="Atins, the finishing line for Kite Safari 4 and 5">
				<h3 style="margin-top:10px">Atins, the finishing line for Kite Safari 4 and 5</h3>
				<div class="infowindow"><p><img decoding="async" class="size-thumbnail wp-image-25185 alignleft" src="https://freeridekitesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/kite_atins7-150x150.jpg" alt="Downwinder Brazil" width="150" height="150">Atins is a kitesurfers paradise, hidden at the foot of The Lençóis Maranhenses National Park. There is no better way to end such an epic journey. There is no better way to end such an epic journey.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"></div>
